method.why: a "0 violations" result is only evidence if the detector demonstrably fires on a known defect
method.how: synthetic defects (clipped text, spilling text, correctly-ellipsised text, an element painting past the right edge, an element clipped away past the right edge, an overlapping card pair, a card pair with a 120px dead band) are injected into a scratch container on a throwaway page, measured, then removed
method.guarantee: nothing the concept owns is modified; the page is closed immediately afterwards

paintedOverflowRecord.text: SELFTEST paints past the right edge

method.themeMechanism: localStorage 'pm.theme' set via addInitScript before any page script runs
method.modes: resize = one load per theme then setViewportSize per width (settle 500ms); fresh = a fresh load at that viewport (360 and 2500 only)

checks.b: no element rect.right > innerWidth + 1 (each violation additionally classified: clipped by a scrolling ancestor or not)
checks.c: every leaf text node element: scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1 OR text-overflow:ellipsis
checks.d: console errors + pageerrors counted; font-CDN failures reported separately, never suppressed

method.enumeration: every one of the 13 rooms is visited; controls visible in that room are enumerated (rect > 0, not inside .pm-hidden), deduped by a reload-stable CSS path (never uid-based)
method.scrollIntoView: each control is scrolled to the centre of its scroller BEFORE the hit-test and BEFORE the click — the room canvases are taller than the viewport, and hit-testing or clicking an off-screen coordinate would libel a live control as dead
method.hitTest: document.elementFromPoint(centre) must return the control or a descendant of it
method.accessibleName: aria-label | aria-labelledby | rendered text | title | data-tip (title/data-tip recorded as tooltip-only)
method.liveTest: a real mouse click at the control centre; before/after signature = body innerHTML hash + text hash + card count + active room + open-popover count + localStorage hash + toast count. Page reloaded every 10 clicks so state cannot cascade.
method.noOpByDesign: a control that is already the current selection (an .active rail tab, the .on disclosure level, the .on width preset, the current title-bar page tab) or a close button for a popover that is not open cannot change anything when clicked; those are classified separately and are NOT reported as dead
method.note: the click test is a DOM-EFFECT test, not a dispatch-count test

method.tiling: pairwise rect overlap (>1px x >1px) + largest empty rectangle inside the union box of the cards, measured twice: raw (as painted) and gutter-compensated (each card inflated by half the computed CSS gap, so the intentional gutter is not counted as dead space)
method.flash: rects sampled every ~60ms for ~700ms after each mutation; any card whose rect collapses to 0 width or 0 height mid-transition is a flash
method.persistence: localStorage 'pmw:u11-overview' read back, then a real reload compares uid/type/span

gapMetricLegend.largestGapRaw: largest empty rectangle inside the union box of the cards, as painted (the 10px design gutter shows up here and is not a defect)
gapMetricLegend.largestGapGutterCompensated: same, with every card inflated by half the computed CSS gap so the intentional gutter cannot register
gapMetricLegend.largestInteriorGap: gutter-compensated, restricted to rows above the top of the final row — this is real dead space INSIDE the board; empty room at the end of the last row is excluded because an unfilled tail is not a hole

dragOutcomes.method: the drop coordinate is re-read from the target card's LIVE rect 520ms after the lift, because lifting a card reflows the board with a FLIP animation and a coordinate captured before (or during) that reflow no longer sits over the intended card — earlier revisions of this probe produced false negatives for exactly that reason
dragOutcomes.timingSensitivity: with no settle, 4 of 4 attempts failed to reorder; with a 520ms settle, reorder succeeded on the pristine and post-add boards and still did not take on the post-resize and post-remove boards. Reorder is therefore PROVEN to work (rendered order changed, verified by card titles), while the two remaining null cases are NOT characterised well enough to call an engine defect — they need a human hand-drag to confirm.
dragOutcomes.note: in every drag the lift was real (a lifted clone plus a placeholder exist mid-drag) and no ghost or placeholder survived the release
